about: Request budgets (OSDS glossary): the most requests per kilometre driven OSDS may make to one public service. A session gets 'burst' requests to fill the first Ring, then 'perKm' for every kilometre driven. Values are estimates sized from a Ring of radius 1 (about 6 new Tiles per km at zoom 16, 0.47 km a side) and each service's published policy; the Long drive reports the real counts per service. A host not listed uses 'default'. Each host has a tier: 'essential' (roads, elevation, aerial imagery: never refused, still counted and reported) or 'enrichment' (everything else, refused once over its own allowance, so enrichment is deferred first and never takes from an essential host).

prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com.policy: USGS 3DEP elevation files on S3: the measured ground under the roads; same numbers as the default (estimate)

s3.amazonaws.com.policy: Terrarium elevation tiles on S3, one per Tile: the ground under the roads; same numbers as the default (estimate)

tiles.openfreemap.org.policy: OpenFreeMap: free public vector tiles, no key, fair use; one request per vector tile (estimate)

photon.komoot.io.policy: Photon search: a few searches per session, 1 request/s spacing enforced (estimate)

overpass-api.de.policy: Overpass: very limited public service, queries are heavy; only on demand, never per Tile (estimate)

imagery.geoplatform.gov.policy: USGS/NAIP imagery: one photograph per Tile, spacing 1 s enforced (estimate)

api.panoramax.xyz.policy: Panoramax street photos: spacing 1 s enforced (estimate)
